card.name: Prepositions after a completed clause
card.fires_on: Short prepositions such as in, after, from, on, and sometimes some or the, that come right after a verb or noun phrase and introduce where, when, or in whom something happened.

modes.label: in before a setting
modes.description: The word in introduces a place, population, or time after a finished statement.

modes.label: Other linking prepositions
modes.description: Words like after, from, on, or some link a clause to a condition, starting point, or circumstance.
